title: F13: Prompt v3, non-item guard, Pfand sign, category revision
milestone: M6 Evaluation
labels: backend, frontend, ai, contracts
---
## Goal
Payment and tax lines no longer end up as line items, a Pfand's sign (cost or money back) is right or flagged, and the category list is simpler: `groceries` (fresh + staples), `drinks` (incl. alcohol) and a new `pet` (decisions 0025, 0026).

**Depends on:** F10
**Built by:** `backend-dev` ∥ `frontend-dev`, after the contract-first wiki commit

## Acceptance criteria
### Backend
- [ ] Category list per `domain-logic.md#categories`: `api/schemas.py` Literals (`SpendingCategory`, `Category`, `LineItemCategory`), `domain/categories.py`, `leaks.CATEGORY_LABELS` (`groceries` "Groceries", `drinks` "Drinks", `pet` "Pet supplies"), `docs/openapi.json` regenerated
- [ ] Seed: fresh + staples lists → `groceries`, alcohol list → `drinks`, a new `pet` section; seed tests green; a test that pet food categorises as `pet`
- [ ] Demo seed retargeted (`groceries`, the spike pattern on `drinks`); scenarios 2 and 3 still work
- [ ] Prompt `v3` (v2 + item-area boundary + sign-first Pfand rule), `OUTPUT_SPECS["v3"]` reusing v2's schema and example, default `PROMPT_VERSION=v3`; v2 frozen by a SHA-256 test; `test_v3_rules`
- [ ] `domain/non_items.py`: `is_non_item`, `is_deposit_return`; table-driven tests (dropped: SUMME, Rückgeld, MwSt 19%, EC-Karte; kept: Pfand zurück, Leergut, BARILLA SPAGHETTI, Barbecue Sauce); fixed-size ReDoS test
- [ ] Pipeline: after redaction and before the facts, drop non-items and negate a positive deposit return; counts logged through fixed templates only; raw output unchanged
- [ ] `assess`: `deposit_sign_suspect` on `line_items[i]` per the flag table, ordered after `sum_mismatch`; `FlagCode` updated; table-driven tests incl. two deposit lines where only one flip matches
- [ ] Synthetic recorded fixtures via `scripts/make_fixtures.py`: `payment_lines_as_items`, `deposit_trailing_minus`, `deposit_return_unsigned`, `deposit_sign_suspect`, each with a pipeline test

### Frontend
- [ ] `js/categories.js`: new `CATEGORIES` order and labels; no old key anywhere in `frontend/`
- [ ] `deposit_sign_suspect` shows on its item row with its message (not filtered out like `uncategorized_item`)

### Both
- [ ] `make check` passes; reviewer agent and `/code-review` ran
- [ ] The student reset local data (delete the SQLite file under `data/`, `make seed-demo`), compared v2 and v3 on the problem receipts on the host, and ran `make docker-check`
